# Legal What?

> Lexara is a jurisdiction-aware conversational legal AI with extensive knowledge across 40+ areas of law. Talk live by voice or text, analyze and revise uploaded documents and media, identify jurisdiction-specific requirements, find and use appropriate local legal forms, and create legal documents. Try LegalWhat free for 3 days, then only $19.99/month.

Legal What? provides legal information and AI-assisted tools. It does not constitute legal advice.

## Services
- [AI legal consultation](https://legalwhat.com/services/ai-legal-consultation/): Lexara provides animated, natural two-way voice and text legal interaction across 40+ areas of law, media analysis and revision, and jurisdiction-aware legal document workflows.

## Search-intent resources
- [Legal AI and research guides](https://legalwhat.com/guides/): Conversational legal AI, two-way voice/text interaction, AI legal research, case analysis, evidence/media analysis, OSINT, public records, criminal procedure, appeals, post-conviction research, drafting, and document review.
- [AI legal document library](https://legalwhat.com/documents/): Public discovery pages for motions, complaints, contracts, demand letters, affidavits, appellate briefs, habeas petitions, FOIA requests, sentencing memoranda, and legal research memoranda.

LegalWhat's public discovery architecture describes capabilities in natural language while private user conversations, accounts, and protected workspaces remain outside search indexing.
